name: Nairobi, Kenya
source: NISAR PROVISIONAL GCOV + GUNW · ESA WorldCover 2021
message: Measured HH/HV on 2 dates; exploratory peer deviations only. Too few dates for curve-shape classification. GUNW has quality-filtered samples on a separate date axis.

worldcover.attribution: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium

steps: Authenticated HTTP Range read of HDF5 native windows; subset arrays saved with SHA-256
Check track 57 ascending frame 1, frequency A, GCOV HH/HV, exact GUNW reference/secondary date match
Transform WGS84 preview locations to EPSG:32737, nearest native samples; reject GCOV mask 0/255, nonfinite/nonpositive power; 10log10 gamma0
GUNW HH 80m: coherence >=0.7, valid nonwater subswaths, no RSLC anomaly flags, ionosphere screen uncertainty <=1 rad; bit24 interpolation flagged, retain only reference connected component
Subtract ionosphere screen, then spatial reference phase; convert with -c/(4*pi*f)*100 cm, positive toward sensor; epoch zero is a reference definition
Sample ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 at preview coordinates
Per channel/date same-class preview peers within 1 km, exclude self, minimum 10; median and 1.4826*MAD
limitations: One 12-day pair: no deformation trend, subsidence rate or event attribution
Apparent relative LOS change, positive toward sensor; spatial reference selected by coherence, stability not established
Ionosphere screen subtracted; troposphere and solid Earth tides not corrected, residual phase may not be ground motion
Product-interpolated ionosphere screen retained where bit 24 is set, flagged per sample; require screen uncertainty <=1 rad
WorldCover 2021 v200 is historical context, not contemporaneous land cover
Sparse nearest-native samples, no area aggregation, no anomaly classification or patch area
Peers use sparse preview locations within 1 km, minimum 10 valid samples; median and 1.4826*MAD; no deformation peer band

sample_analysis.z_definition: (sample dB - same-class local median dB) / robust spread dB
sample_analysis.classifier: pipeline.classify; >=2 valid samples per segment; shift >=2.5 robust units
limitations: Sparse samples, no area or continuous raster
Curve shapes are not confirmed clearing, flood, earthquake or subsidence
No weather correction or labelled accuracy estimate
